utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout already—everyone seems to be pitching in. I’m not totally sure of the final details yet, but it sounds like it’s coming together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a confirmed list of who’s coming and what they’re bringing? I’d rather not assume it’s set until I see the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not confirmed yet, no — I just know folks are talking about it and it looks promising. As soon as I see the actual list, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m hearing a repair drive come together, and I’m in. If that’s the plan everyone’s on, I can help spread it and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Awesome, thanks Vik — I’m still piecing it together, but if you can help spread the word, that’d be huge. I’ll send the details once I’ve got them straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — send me the details when they’re set, and I’ll repeat the same plan to folks and help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Best place to start is the busted porch light by the corner house — folks keep tripping on it after dark. I also heard the community bench near the garden’s wobbling bad, so that’s probably next.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Porch light first. I’ll bring a ladder and wire.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we should keep it simple and check the repair drive first. If you want, I can help sort out what’s actually broken.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, let’s do that first. I’ll make a note of what we find so we don’t lose track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good call. I’ll take a look at the drive now, and we can compare notes after.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need the actual neighborhood context or conversation details to answer as Faye.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — we’re planning the repair drive for the neighborhood lot this weekend, and I’m just trying to line up who’s bringing tools and who’s bringing snacks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring snacks and a basic tool kit, but I need a tight pickup-friendly time window—what time are we starting and how long will it run?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to stick with a clear plan for the repair drive—just tell me the time, place, and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — let’s meet at the community center on Saturday morning, and bring a pair of gloves and a screwdriver if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — Saturday morning at the community center, with gloves and a screwdriver. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — could you please nail down who’s handling what and by when? I’d feel better once there’s a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll map out the roles and deadlines today, then share a clear plan with everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest? I’m still catching up with everyone around here.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you asked — we’re still on track, but a couple of details are being finalized, so I’m double-checking everything before I post the full update. I’ll send the latest in the group chat as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on the group chat. If you need anything from me in the meantime, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to verify the details first before we act on anything. What’s confirmed so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far, only that we’re checking the details before anything gets started—nothing beyond that has been confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that’s helpful. I’ll keep waiting for confirmed details before I treat anything as decided.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, but I can check on the repair drive and tell you what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks—just let me know what’s confirmed when you check. I’ll piece together the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll do that and only pass on what I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs repairing, and when are you planning the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still gathering the list, but it’s mostly small home fixes and busted tools folks can bring by. I’m aiming for this weekend, somewhere flexible—once I pin down the spot, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m ready to keep track of the repair drive details exactly. Just point me to the location and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — I’m heading to the repair shop now, and I’ll send the exact address as soon as I’m stopped. Just keep an eye out for it, and I’ll give you the gist between rides.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll be ready for the exact address and I’ll pin down the location as soon as you send it. Safe ride, Bo; I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m in—just point me at the next repair and I’ll pitch in where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. I’ll point you to the next repair when I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just give me a shout when you see it, and I’ll head over with whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s pin down the plan early—what exactly are we collecting, where does it go, and who’s handling transport?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not signing off on anything yet—what exactly are we collecting, and do you have a source or written plan for where it’s going? If you want me to confirm transport, I need names and details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to keep it simple: let’s get the written list first, then the destination and transport names can follow. Once that’s in hand, I can sign off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing this repair drive — it feels like one of those things that pulls everybody together. I’ll help spread the word and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be lovely, Jules — thank you. I’ll keep to the original plan and we’ll see it through together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll keep folks focused on the original plan too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a fresh page ready for the repair drive—what supplies should I write down first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Start with the basics: duct tape, zip ties, screwdrivers, and a few spare bulbs. If we’ve got batteries or extension cords, I’d put those down too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m writing down duct tape, zip ties, screwdrivers, spare bulbs, batteries, and extension cords. If anything else comes to mind, I’ll add it carefully.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive might kick off this weekend, but I haven’t seen the final notice yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear for sure!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I really need the final timing before I can commit. If you hear anything, send it my way and I’ll work it around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll pass along the exact timing as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — just give me the gist and I’ll keep us moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — the gist is we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything shifts. If you want, I can send the updated details in the chat so we’re all aligned.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send the update in chat and I’ll roll with it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take a look at first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the front gate hinge and the leaky tap. Those are the big ones.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right, front gate hinge and the leaky tap — I’ll start with those two and see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the word out about the repair drive right away and make sure everyone hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. Let me know if I can help in any way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll spread the word and keep you posted if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is on Maple Court, just past the community garden—easy to spot if you’re coming from the north entrance. I’m pretty sure that’s the exact spot, but I can confirm it if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine to me, Opal. Let’s stick with Maple Court by the north entrance unless you find out otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll treat Maple Court by the north entrance as the spot unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly do you need from me for the repair drive—money, time, or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the list first, then I can tell you whether it’s money, time, or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s too vague. What’s on the list, specifically?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard a few folks saying the repair drive’s picking up speed, but the details are still a bit patchy. I can check around and bring you the latest if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be kind of you, Ira. I’d appreciate the latest whenever you can get it—I keep mixing up what’s on when.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and sort out the schedule for you. I’ll bring back whatever solid details I can find.
